page.content:
Armandra is a fictional character created by the late British author Brian Lumley for his Titus Crow series of Cthulhu Mythos stories. She has an important role in Lumley's novel "In the Moons of Borea".

page.overview:
Who is Armandra?

Armandra is a fictional character created by the late British author Brian Lumley for his Titus Crow series of Cthulhu Mythos stories. She has an important role in Lumley's novel "In the Moons of Borea".

Daughter of the Great Old One Ithaqua, Armandra is a powerful sorceress and priestess who wages war against her parent. She uses magic, but is also telepathic. A highly strung but heroic character, she assists the human protagonists of the Titus Crow series and other interlinked stories against Ithaqua and other Mythos entities until final victory.

Category:Magic Users Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
